scope: New wording/behavior judgments frozen before search output inspection. Previously exposed repositories; implementer-authored and non-exhaustive. No independent reviewer, model or agent outcome. Eight questions, two distinct source files each. All auto mode, daily MCP, 2000 tokens; 5/24/scoped pages, fixed first-named-hit inspection.

acceptance.correctness: Regression fixtures must pass; old ranking gate unchanged. Compare identity, negation, expansion separately and combined to baseline. No aggregate file/visible/inspection loss in either split, no scoped individual loss. Report all unscoped individual losses. p95 <= max(100ms, 1.5x baseline). No required gain for correctness, no usefulness claim from a pass. Reject unsupported expansion changes.
acceptance.resources: One pack at a time, cached sources only, 512MiB managed storage, 1.5GiB RSS, 180 seconds per process; no models/cloud/downloads. Validation inspected once candidate frozen; no tuning after validation.
